def xar_entries(data):
    """Read this XAR using its exact TOC offsets and both stored/extracted checksums."""
    magic,header_size,version,compressed_size,xml_size,algorithm=struct.unpack_from('>4sHHQQI',data,0)
    assert magic==b'xar!' and header_size==28 and version==1 and algorithm==1
    heap=header_size+compressed_size
    assert heap<=len(data)
    compressed=data[header_size:heap]
    xml=zlib.decompress(compressed)
    assert len(xml)==xml_size
    root=ET.fromstring(xml)
    toc=root.find('toc');assert toc is not None
    checksum=toc.find('checksum');assert checksum.get('style')=='sha1'
    digest_start=heap+int(checksum.findtext('offset'))
    digest_size=int(checksum.findtext('size'));assert digest_size==20
    assert data[digest_start:digest_start+digest_size]==hashlib.sha1(compressed).digest()
    ranges=[(digest_start,digest_start+digest_size)]
    entries={}
    for node in toc.findall('file'):
        name=node.findtext('name')
        assert name in ('PackageInfo','Payload','Bom') and name not in entries
        assert node.findtext('type')=='file' and node.find('file') is None
        row=node.find('data');assert row is not None
        start=heap+int(row.findtext('offset'));length=int(row.findtext('length'))
        expected_size=int(row.findtext('size'));end=start+length
        assert start>=heap and length>=0 and end<=len(data)
        assert all(end<=a or start>=b for a,b in ranges)
        ranges.append((start,end));stored=data[start:end]
        archived=row.find('archived-checksum');extracted=row.find('extracted-checksum')
        assert archived.get('style')==extracted.get('style')=='sha1'
        assert hashlib.sha1(stored).hexdigest()==archived.text
        encoding=row.find('encoding').get('style')
        assert encoding in ('application/octet-stream','application/x-gzip')
        payload=stored if encoding=='application/octet-stream' else zlib.decompress(stored)
        assert len(payload)==expected_size
        assert hashlib.sha1(payload).hexdigest()==extracted.text
        entries[name]={'mode_type':stat.S_IFREG,'size':expected_size,'link':None,'data':payload,
                       'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'stored_bytes':length,
                       'archived_sha1':archived.text,'extracted_sha1':extracted.text,
                       'encoding':encoding,'offset':start,'both_checksums_verified':True}
    assert set(entries)=={'PackageInfo','Payload','Bom'}
    assert sorted(ranges)[-1][1]==len(data)
    return entries,'XAR v1; direct TOC offsets, compressed TOC SHA1 and both per-entry SHA1 verified'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read native Product receipts/full logs/CSV only; run no tests or benchmarks."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cab_audit', HERE/'audit_cab_artifact.py')
cab = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(cab)
SOURCE = '47345c81db8aefbf9ae51a2684d546119bb9ae32'
RUN = 38091545238


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def outputs_from_lasttest(text):
    parts = list(re.finditer(r'^\d+/\d+ Testing: (.+)\r?$', text, re.M))
    outputs = {}
    tails = {}
    for i, match in enumerate(parts):
        name = match.group(1).strip()
        assert name not in outputs, ('Duplicate LastTest name',name)
        block = text[match.end():parts[i+1].start() if i+1<len(parts) else len(text)]
        output = re.search(r'^Output:\r?\n-{5,}\r?\n(.*?)^<end of output>\r?$',block,re.M|re.S)
        assert output is not None, ('Missing full LastTest output',name)
        outputs[name] = output.group(1).rstrip('\r\n')
        tails[name] = block[output.end():]
    return outputs,tails


def one_marker(text,prefix):
    rows = [dict(cab.v.ROW.findall(x)) for x in text.splitlines() if x.startswith(prefix+' ')]
    assert len(rows)==1,(prefix,rows)
    return rows[0]


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--integration',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--dsp',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--release',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    inventory=read(args.integration/'ctest-inventory.json')
    junit=ET.parse(args.integration/'ctest-results.xml').getroot()
    tests=list(junit.iter('testcase'))
    names=[t.get('name') for t in tests]
    inventory_names=[t['name'] for t in inventory['tests']]
    assert len(names)==len(inventory_names)==38
    assert len(set(names))==len(names) and set(names)==set(inventory_names)
    logs=list(args.dsp.rglob('LastTest.log'))
    assert len(logs)==1
    full=logs[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    texts,tails=outputs_from_lasttest(full)
    assert set(texts)==set(names)
    results=[]
    for test in tests:
        name=test.get('name')
        passed=(test.get('status')=='run' and all(test.find(k) is None for k in ('failure','error','skipped')))

"""Single acquisition of one exact connector-provided URL, with ZIP/hash audit."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat
import urllib.request
import zipfile


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--metadata', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--request', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--directory', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    meta = json.loads(args.metadata.read_text())
    assert meta['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == '47345c81db8aefbf9ae51a2684d546119bb9ae32'
    assert meta['workflow_run']['id'] in (38091545218, 38091545238)
    assert not meta['expired']
    directory = args.directory
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archive_path = directory / f"artifact-{meta['id']}.zip"
    extracted = directory / f"artifact-{meta['id']}"
    receipt_path = directory / 'download-receipt.json'
    assert not archive_path.exists() and not extracted.exists() and not receipt_path.exists(), 'Refuse duplicate acquisition'
    receipt = {'artifact_id':meta['id'], 'artifact_name':meta['name'], 'download_attempts':1,
               'api_digest':meta['digest'], 'api_bytes':meta['size_in_bytes'], 'complete':False}
    failed = False
    try:
        provided = json.loads(args.request.read_text())
        request = urllib.request.Request(provided['download_url'], headers={'User-Agent':'CAB-evidence-audit'})
        checksum, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response, archive_path.open('xb') as output:
            while True:
                data = response.read(1024*1024)
                if not data:
                    break
                output.write(data)
                size += len(data)
                checksum.update(data)
        receipt.update(bytes=size, sha256=checksum.hexdigest(), zip=archive_path.name)
        assert size == meta['size_in_bytes'], 'API/ZIP size mismatch'
        assert 'sha256:'+checksum.hexdigest() == meta['digest'], 'API/ZIP digest mismatch'
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            members = archive.infolist()
            names = [x.filename for x in members]
            assert len(names) == len(set(names)), 'Duplicate ZIP member'
            for member in members:
                name = PurePosixPath(member.filename)
                assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts and '\\' not in member.filename
                assert not stat.S_ISLNK(member.external_attr >> 16), 'Unexpected outer ZIP symlink'
            assert archive.testzip() is None, 'ZIP CRC failure'
            extracted.mkdir()
            archive.extractall(extracted)
        inventory = []
        for p in sorted(extracted.rglob('*')):
            if p.is_file():
                data = p.read_bytes()
                inventory.append({'path':p.relative_to(extracted).as_posix(), 'bytes':len(data),
                                  'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
        (directory/'downloaded-files.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+'\n')
        native_index = extracted/'SHA256SUMS.json'
        if native_index.exists():
            rows = json.loads(native_index.read_text())
            expected = {x['path']:x for x in rows}
            actual = {x['path']:x for x in inventory if x['path'] != 'SHA256SUMS.json'}
            assert len(expected)==len(rows) and expected==actual, 'Native file index mismatch'
            receipt.update(native_index_verified=True,native_indexed_files=len(rows),
                           native_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256(native_index.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        else:
            receipt['native_index_verified'] = None
        receipt.update(complete=True, zip_members=len(members), extracted_files=len(inventory),
                       extracted=extracted.name)
    except BaseException as error:
        failed = True
        receipt.update(error_type=type(error).__name__, http_status=getattr(error,'code',None))
    finally:
        args.request.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
    if failed:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
